units.source_text: 我拖着筋疲力尽的身体艰难起来。

en.t: Dragging my utterly exhausted body, I struggled to get up.

units.source_text: 妻子遗落的小刀正好落在我的视线里。

en.t: The small knife my wife had dropped came right into my line of sight.

units.source_text: 我拿着它，用力捅了自己的胸口。

en.t: I took it and drove it hard into my own chest.

units.source_text: 嘴里涌进血腥味，但我丝毫没有察觉的痛苦。

en.t: The taste of blood welled into my mouth, but I felt not the slightest pain.

units.source_text: 胸口凉了下来，周围彻底安静下来。

en.t: My chest grew cold, and everything around me fell utterly silent.

units.source_text: 一只鸟的叫声都听不到，只有几束夕阳寂静的飘在竹林和杉树枝头。

en.t: Not even a single birdcall could be heard; only a few shafts of evening sunlight drifted silently over the bamboo grove and the tips of the cedars.

units.source_text: 阳光渐渐暗了下来，竹林和杉树也看不见了。

en.t: The sunlight gradually dimmed, and the bamboo grove and cedars disappeared from sight.

units.source_text: 我倒在地上，被一片静穆的氛围笼罩。

en.t: I lay fallen on the ground, enveloped in a solemn stillness.
